scene.coordinates: World-frame metre estimates derived from calibrated head RGB rays intersected with category-specific nominal planes.
scene.z_rule: 0.765 + nominal category HEIGHT / 2, not the current vertical position of a lifted object.
scene.absence: No returned object is not proof of failed grasp: detector, crop, proposal filtering, CLIP semantics, or occlusion can remove a physically present object.
scene.forbidden_inference: Do not use scene Z increase, unchanged instance suffix, or disappearance alone as a grasp-success test.

approach.current_failure_mode: This deployed compatibility adapter returns primitive_error=no_collision_free_path plus observed state when planning rejects BEFORE any trajectory execution. Other exceptions remain exceptions.
approach.documented_legacy_mode: robot.approach(arm="left" or "right", position_m=[x,y,z], quaternion_wxyz=[w,x,y,z]); collision-aware released CuRobo joint trajectory, other arm/gripper preserved; raises RuntimeError if no path. No pose success claim.
approach.current_success: Observed joints after bounded trajectory execution; not a grasp, pose-accuracy, or task-success assertion.
approach.recovery: A zero-execution planning rejection can be considered separately from uncertain partial physical execution. A recovery policy still requires frozen limits and native validation; no unlimited retry.

gripper.current_output: Observed joint state after six setpoint steps

budget.proposed_interface_change_not_implemente: Consider exposing executed primitive steps and remaining task budget with explicit semantics; test zero-action rejection versus partial cancellation.
